name: command
title: Command Palette
blurb: Command palette for searching and executing commands with grouped shortcuts.
description: A compound component wrapping cmdk library with styled input, grouped results, keyboard shortcuts display, and dialog wrapper for full-screen command palette UI.
use_when: Building command palettes (⌘K), quick action menus, or searchable command interfaces.
avoid_when: Simple dropdown menus — use a select component instead.
a11y: cmdk provides keyboard navigation and search. CommandDialog wraps in an accessible dialog.
